question: Can one I3 scalar logit-mixing weight fitted only on separate TRAIN recover low interface tax and supplied-full-target copying on the complete existing DEV panels?

base_signature.qualification: Compare at initialization and after CPU/device transfer; also record full source-file SHA256s.

design.vocabulary_support: Full released-model head; no tokenizer mask or temperature transform
design.mixture: I6: raw logits + w*(I3 note logits-raw logits)
design.zero_endpoint: w0 uses an explicit raw identity branch, checked bytewise for every TRAIN mode token vector; w1 full-logit result is compared with the actual unmixed note branch on every TRAIN row.
design.fit_rule: Highest mean TRAIN correct full16 LL among grid weights with mean TRAIN empty-minus-raw>=-.4; exact ties smaller weight; w0 exact identity is always available.
design.train_selection: Literal first256 unique TRAIN documents in the original pinned production file order; native prefix512/future16, no outcome selection; no TRAIN/DEV document overlap.
design.dev_selection: Unchanged original GENERAL256 + supervised ARITHMETIC first256; all512 cohort items retained (505 unique source documents,7 shared across cohorts). Arithmetic requested512/available320 publication is unchanged; remaining64 is not an untouched held256.

cohort_document_overlap.later_postsft: Separate sealed exclusions and inventory; current pools unchanged

design.primary: Per-document sum over original full16 GENERAL targets; complete original source numeral plus actual native closing certificate for ARITHMETIC.
design.secondary: K1; arithmetic numeric-token-overlap sum, never substituted for the full-span gates.
design.control_semantics: GENERAL correct copies the actual future16; corrupt uses a different-document real future16 and other uses a distinct donor. ARITHMETIC correct copies the complete native target; corrupt mutates one numeric digit to a different exact value. All controls use matched fixed I3 close/reanchor bytes.
design.gate_rule: Inclusive cohort point-mean screens; confidence intervals are reported separately, not additional selection conditions.

publication.fit_rule: Highest mean TRAIN correct full16 LL among grid weights with mean TRAIN empty-minus-raw>=-.4; exact ties smaller weight; w0 exact identity is always available.

limitations: Constrained one-dimensional grid fit, not a learned MLP or exact Quiet-STaR.
Future-visible full-target-copy oracle; not a useful generated-note policy.
Same DEV outcomes reused after six-interface exploration.

endpoints.identity_scope: w0 reuses the actual already-materialized I6 raw vector. Zero tax also means zero note-dependent utility at that endpoint; it is not an oracle gain.

correct_minus_raw.qualification: Sampling uncertainty conditional on these checkpoints; not training-seed uncertainty.

numeric_only_descriptive.caveat: Uses the preexisting native-token overlap mask: any indivisible token overlapping the numeral is included, even if it also contains other bytes. This is secondary descriptive LL, not arithmetic correctness. Its raw mean headroom is0.6476nat, so a2nat mean gain is unattainable for this secondary metric; no2nat gate is applied to it.

train_live_mapping.qualification: TRAIN finished before the first live physical-mapping capture. Launch PID/start/environment receipts and actual numerical gates/physical closure remain; do not infer a captured live TRAIN mapping.

publication.explanation: I6 recomputes actual raw full-head logits once/document so nonzero mixtures have every vocabulary value. PriorPhase1 raw selectedLPs are not silently reused as full logits; small FP32 execution-graph differences are preserved. w0 byte identity refers to the actual I6 raw branch.

costs.counting: Row scoring wall times are per actual raw or note forward plus associated mixed softmax/transfer, summed once per saved row. Model setup is separate; no FLOP-equivalence or throughput claim. Nine TRAIN weights are one broadcast grid, not nine model forward passes.
costs.extra_raw_pass: Each document computes one raw forward and each note-mode forward plus mixing softmax; extra clean pass is not free unless already available.

cpu_checks.scope: CPU/source checks do not qualify SFT or distributed resumption.

interpretation: TRAIN selects3/8 with empty-minus-raw−0.20948nat;0.5 is ineligible at−0.40303 under the frozen−0.4 constraint. No DEV outcome enters this fit.
GENERAL passes all three declared point gates: tax−0.15368nat, full-target-copy gain+11.94817nat, correct-minus-corrupt+12.20312nat.

ARITHMETIC has positive supplied-copy full-span gain+0.64065nat and correct-minus-corrupt+0.24902nat, with positive intervals, but fails both declared+2nat gates. Empty tax−0.01768nat passes. This is not zero utility, and it is not a passed arithmetic gate.
Arithmetic full-span raw headroom is2.06154nat and includes closing-boundary tokens. Numeric-only raw headroom is0.64761nat; digit likelihood and scalar correctness are distinct endpoints.

This is future-visible literal target-copy plumbing with a frozen B0 and an extra raw forward, not useful prefix-only generated thought, learned arithmetic, a deployed policy, or a reproduction of the full Quiet-STaR training system.

The shared scalar is TRAIN fitted, but the DEV panels are reused after six-interface exploration. Document intervals are conditional on this checkpoint/panel, without multiplicity correction or training-seed uncertainty.

All original Phase1 scores remain unchanged. The actual I6 raw graph differs by at most2.36034e−5nat/token from prior raw scoring; this descriptive numerical difference is not a new gate or rewritten baseline.
